- "We want streaming like websocket fastness — users notice 100ms jumps" — CTO.
- Primary workload: multi-turn in-app chat (support and quick answer flows), occasional long-form summarization of ticket threads.
- Expected peak concurrency: 120 simultaneous active users across accounts during demo spikes; average qps low.
- Want hosted API to start (self-serve); will consider Dedicated if latency/noise becomes an issue.
- Security: SOC2 required, SSO (SAML) for admin console, audit logs for data access. No on-prem or residency needs today.

- Ran Redwood hosted API basic perf test with smaller open models; saw average streaming latency 80-120ms but tail spiked ~250ms on cold starts. Interested in batching/kv-cache suggestions.
- We shared a small sample app for SDK feedback (drive link above). SE recommended streaming endpoint + client-side partial-render patterns.

Sales/ops notes:
- Arr estimate small but strategic for expansion into paid tiers; low-touch AE motion preferred.
- Quote ask: example monthly cost for 50k tokens/mo with streaming and 1 retained convo context.
